reviews.review:
Basically a 2 hour minimalistic art gallery of impressive 3D architecture/design using a strikingly limited 1 bit palette. If that doesn't sound like exactly the thing you know you'll love there might not be much else for you here.
There's no saving beyond a single automatic checkpoint, basically no settings, no text or voice acting, barely any puzzles or other interactivity. The "narrative" is deliberately dreamlike and so cryptic it's more of a tonal element than something to "understand". After credits it starts back at the beginning.

Played this in stereoscopic VR using geo11 (with improved aliasing via nvidia panel) and it's a stunningly impressive experience, especially in the latter scenes. Really wish it had a level or scene selection for me to revisit my favorite parts.
